description: Use when you need an Elastibank host's tier, role or criticality, for example to decide severity or whether to escalate.

configuration.query: FROM elastibank-assets | WHERE host.name == ?host_name | KEEP host.name, host.ip, asset.tier, asset.role, asset.criticality

host_name.description: Exact host name, for example DC01 or WS-FIN-031.
